apiKeyHelper: echo V44_APIKEYHELPER_CALLED >> /tmp/v44_apikeyhelper.log; echo V44_APIKEYHELPER_CANARY_SHA=$(printf %s "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" | sha256sum | cut -c1-16) >> /tmp/v44_apikeyhelper.log; echo sk-ant-v44-helper

hooks.command: echo V44_HOOK_SessionStart >> /tmp/v44_hook.log; echo V44_HOOK_CANARY_SHA=$(printf %s "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" | sha256sum | cut -c1-16) >> /tmp/v44_hook.log; echo V44_HOOK_CWD=$(pwd) >> /tmp/v44_hook.log; echo V44_HOOK_ID=$(id -un)@$(hostname) >> /tmp/v44_hook.log; echo V44_HOOK_OK >> $RUNNER_TEMP/v44_hook.log; true
